text:
I need to verify if RMS Carmania was a Cunard ocean liner launched on September 20th, 1906.

RMS Carmania was indeed a Cunard Line ocean liner. It was launched on September 21, 1904, not September 20, 1906.

The ship launched on September 20, 1906 was RMS Mauretania, which was also a Cunard ocean liner.

Verdict: INCORRECT
Confidence: 0.95
